title: Optimisation of the microwave-assisted extraction process of bioactive compounds with antioxidant activity from cocoa pod husk (Theobroma cacao L.)
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,1869-1882
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00924C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Esteban Jurado-Beizaga, Erick Alvarez-Yanamango, Oscar Herrera-Calderon, Alfredo Ibañez
Cocoa pod husk (CPH), an agro-industrial by-product with disposal and cost challenges, was valorised by optimising microwave-assisted extraction to efficiently recover antioxidants, supporting SDGs 9, 12 and 13 through sustainable green technologies.
